selection_metric: inner held-out total Harrell;OFF preferred at ties;never select on outer error groups
correction: linear RNA512;L2;convex global objective solved to gradient criterion;no new encoder or distillation
random_weights: within-event-owner permutation,identical total event weight mass
pair_honesty: both patients in same held-out teacher block;teacher model selection/preprocessing excludes both labels
scalar_baseline: one RNA risk coordinate from same pair-honest crossfits;no latent-coordinate stacking
scope: single-cohort exploratory;PFI independent secondary;outer errors diagnostic only after all selection locked
